note: The Telopanos weapons are the Limbus furnace's Superior 5 weapons: an Auge Scintistone plus units from Temenos or Apollyon lifts the Telognophos base weapon to this form, and the same furnace adds the Rank 30 rows.  Every row is at its Rank 30 value.  `bundle` is the client's own augment bundle index (512 entries; 497-512 are this family), matched to the rows below by content.

model_note: The 2026 wave shipped without a grap model in any server data: LandSandBoat marks these rows `TODO: MId`, and the client's item records carry no model at all (the model is server-side data private servers curate by hand).  An equipped copy was therefore invisible ('no grap model: it will not show').  Each weapon now carries the client model of its own weapon type -- the 2026 'Ethereal' block (929-938) where it names that type, the type's Stage 5 afterglow otherwise -- so it renders with the right silhouette.  These are stand-ins, not the Telopanos skins; `//model <item> <id>` sets one copy's look and a later dataset edit can bake the real id in.  The grip keeps model 0: grips are never drawn.
